additional_info.subject: Note to Handover
additional_info.body:
Problem Description:
I have noticed recurring disconnections with the CCV terminals. Whenever we reboot the charger, the terminal reconnects. However, the issue is not recorded in the error flags as a disconnection. On-site, when we attempt to use the terminal, it remains unresponsive, and the charger displays a "Terminal Communication Timeout" message. I have attached photos and log captures showing that the process aborts before returning to the home screen. Could you investigate the cause of these disconnections? Additionally, we are experiencing frequent disconnections with other CCV terminals as well.
Log level changed- Debug~
For troubleshooting the level should be set to 'debug' temporary. That gives more detailed information.
Please wait for customer feedback and work accordingly.
